name: marble

interface.longDescription:
Marble is a beautiful online Markdown editor and shared workspace.
Connect Marble to find your notes, polish a draft, or start something new. Share a link and write together in real time.
defaultPrompt: Read through all notes in my workspace on Marble, and add a "Table of contents" as a new note.
Save a summary of this conversation as a new note in Marble.
Read the open comments on my latest Marble note and draft replies.

positive.description: Find a note and summarise it
positive.prompt: Find my API v2 migration note on Marble and summarise the plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds "API v2 migration" in the Engineering folder and summarises the four-week plan, the open to-dos and the two decisions, with a link to the note.

positive.description: Add to a note without changing what is there
positive.prompt: Add "Update the SDK changelog" as an unchecked task under To do in my API v2 migration note.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds "- [ ] Update the SDK changelog" at the end of the To do section. Every other line of the note is unchanged.

positive.description: Read and answer a comment thread
positive.prompt: What did Jordan ask in the comments on my API v2 migration note? Reply that we can keep v1 until 15 January.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Jordan's question about keeping v1 until January, then posts the reply in that thread as the reviewer.

positive.description: Create a note in a folder
positive.prompt: Create a note in my Meetings folder on Marble called "Sprint planning — 3 Nov" with sections for Goals, Carry-over and Risks.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the note inside the Meetings folder with the three headings and returns a link to it.

positive.prompt: Is anyone waiting for access to my Infrastructure costs note on Marble? If so, let them view it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Jordan Lee's pending request for Infrastructure costs and approves it with the viewer role.

negative.description: A request with nothing to do with notes
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: A workspace the account cannot reach
negative.prompt: Open the notes in Alex's private workspace on Marble.

negative.description: Bulk deletion without naming what to delete
